Feature: GPIO negative-edge interrupt detection with per-pin and group status handling
Test Description: Verifies negative-edge interrupt generation on each GPIO input and validates per-pin and group status handling and clearing.
Remarks: Build-time selection chooses which GPIO interrupt line is used. A fixed memory-mapped stimulus address is used to generate falling edges. Thirty-two inputs are exercised in sequence.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable the interrupt for the selected GPIO group in INTR_EN1.
2) Initialize the stimulus address 0xA0243ffc to all ones.
3) For each input index from 0 to 31, configure the corresponding GPIO_8 offset for input mode and negative-edge detection.
4) Enable the interrupt for the current input in INTR1_INTR_EN1.
5) Drive a falling edge for the current input by toggling the bit at 0xA0243ffc.
6) Wait until the pending flag clears after the interrupt is serviced.
7) In the interrupt context, read the per-pin control at GPIO_8 (offset for the current input) and confirm the input state reflects the event and the raw interrupt flag is set.
8) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 and confirm the bit for the current input is set.
9) Clear the per-pin interrupt via GPIO_8 (offset for the current input) and verify the per-pin readback matches the cleared value.
10) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 again and verify it is cleared.
11) Clear the system-level raw status for the selected GPIO group in gpio_intr_raw_stclr1.
12) Clear the platform interrupt line.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Per-pin input state during the event reads active; pass if active, fail otherwise.
2) Per-pin raw interrupt flag reads set; pass if set, fail otherwise.
3) Group interrupt status shows the bit for the current input; pass if set, fail otherwise.
4) After per-pin clear, the per-pin readback equals the expected cleared value; pass if matched, fail otherwise.
5) Group interrupt status reads zero after clear; pass if zero, fail otherwise.
6) Final result passes if the test error count is zero at completion.

Test Description: Validates that each GPIO pad drives the intended output value when configured for output mode. Confirms the observed pad state matches the driven value for all 32 pads.
Remarks: Build-time option selects which interrupt line is enabled and cleared. Pad state is verified by reading a fixed address.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable the appropriate platform interrupt line for the selected GPIO instance.
2) Configure all pads from 8 to 39 to operate in output mode.
3) Enable the group interrupt mask for all 32 pads.
4) For each pad from 0 to 31, drive the pad output high and then verify the corresponding bit reads as 1 at the pad-state address.
5) For each pad from 0 to 31, drive the pad output low and then verify the corresponding bit reads as 0 at the pad-state address.
6) After each verification, clear the platform interrupt for the selected GPIO instance.
7) At the end of the sequence, report pass if no errors were detected.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) When a pad is driven high, the corresponding bit read must be 1; pass if 1, fail if not.
2) When a pad is driven low, the corresponding bit read must be 0; pass if 0, fail if not.
3) No unexpected interrupt handler entry occurs during the test; pass if none, fail otherwise.
4) Final result passes if the accumulated error count remains zero at test completion.
